dedupe_keys.name: k demos long term projections of municipal level hourly electricity demand by end use in korea

description: K-DEMOS: Long-term Projections of Municipal-level Hourly Electricity Demand by End Use in Korea is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Hyuntae Choi (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology). K-DEMOS (Korea DEMand at municipal-hOurly Scale) provides hourly electricity demand for all 229 Korean municipalities, disaggregated into four end uses: residential, industrial, commercial-and-other, and transport. Coverage: national (KR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The repository holds 2 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
